rival.name: Alternative contribution rather than cumulative contribution
rival.contract: chol selects one alternative bundle instead of taking their union. Its explicit nondeterministic output is either left or right, with no automatic simultaneous inclusion.
rival.different_consequence: N.4 would then commit only flesh or only bone; W.23 only the fire bundle or only the water bundle. A source-faithful complete reading must still find written ownership for every missing named contribution; it cannot report the same cumulative clause.

design.falsifier: Under these frozen entries, reject a completed account if any daiin must be non-BONE, any ol consumes a non-Element, or any chol returns an equality/truth value instead of a Bundle. More substantively, source-complete claims must entail the separately named flesh AND bone and preserve cumulative fire-plus-water contributions if this chosen phrase owns them. If the alternatives simply recover them elsewhere, record nonselection rather than a false discrimination.
design.strongest_countercase: This reuses the same surface as RAW549. It is retained only because it changes the result type and complete-content obligation: W.23 becomes an unfinished argument, whereas RAW549 made it an equality statement. No existing target evidence establishes that change. The source-named bundle interpretation and unfinished governing relation are substantial costs.

freedom.remaining_content: All other forms and W.23's governing assertion remain unbound; AIR/BREATH and other complete-source clauses still need written ownership.
